scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm --parallel -r dev
scripts.start: pnpm build && pnpm db:up && pnpm db:wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm --parallel --filter @atlas/api --filter @atlas/web start
scripts.prod: cross-env ATLAS_ENV=prod pnpm build && cross-env ATLAS_ENV=prod pnpm db:up && cross-env ATLAS_ENV=prod pnpm db:wait && cross-env ATLAS_ENV=prod pnpm db:migrate && cross-env ATLAS_ENV=prod pnpm --parallel --filter @atlas/api --filter @atlas/web start
scripts.gate: pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -w run lint:knip && pnpm -r test:coverage && pnpm -r build && pnpm -F @atlas/web bundle:check
scripts.e2e:perf: cross-env PERF=1 ATLAS_PERF=1 VITE_ATLAS_PERF=1 playwright test e2e/perf/
scripts.e2e:perf:prod: pnpm -F @atlas/web build && cross-env PERF=1 ATLAS_PERF=1 ATLAS_E2E_PROD=1 VITE_ATLAS_PERF=1 playwright test e2e/perf/ --project=chromium && node scripts/check-perf-floors.mjs --strict
scripts.e2e:forensic: cross-env FORENSIC=1 ATLAS_PERF=1 VITE_ATLAS_PERF=1 playwright test --config playwright.forensic.config.ts e2e/forensic/walkthrough.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:state-transitions: cross-env STATE_TRANSITIONS=1 playwright test --config playwright.forensic.config.ts e2e/forensic/state-transitions.spec.ts
scripts.gate:full: pnpm -w run gate && pnpm -w run e2e
